tool_signatures.name: reindex
tool_signatures.description: Trigger re-indexing of the codebase or a specific path.

path.description: Optional specific directory to re-index (default: entire repo)

embed.description: Also refresh embeddings, using the model this index already holds (or SRCLIGHT_EMBED_MODEL for an index that holds none yet). Pass False for a keyword-only refresh when you only need search_symbols current: embedding a large backlog calls the embedding model and can take minutes. Not free, though — a reindex drops the embeddings of every symbol it replaces, and with embed=False nothing puts them back, so semantic_search and hybrid_search lose coverage on exactly the files being edited. Does nothing when no model is configured or recorded.
